title: cheirostylis marmorifolia
intro: Cheirostylis marmorifolia, commonly known as Marmorated Cheirostylis, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. It is a type of orchid native to parts of Asia, valued for its medicinal and ornamental properties. Cheirostylis marmorifolia has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and acting as an expectorant. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
